content.label: JavaScript kodi
content.description: JavaScript executed by Goja VM. Stored under data.jsCode — this exact key is read by the engine and rendered by the constructor UI. See prompt Pattern 7 for the full runtime API (send_*, db_*, http_*, exit, set_context, ...). To READ state/context PREFER object-access: vars.<key> (public, maps to public_<key>; state.<key> is a legacy alias that still works), private.<key> (secret), and context.<key> (raw key), e.g. vars.user_phone, context.first_name (get_state/get_context also work, but object-access is shorter/cleaner). FORMAT CLEANLY — the engine stores your code verbatim (no auto-format), so write it readable on the FIRST try: one statement per line (never several joined by ';'), consistent 2-space indent for blocks, spaces around operators (a = 1, x === y — not a=1), meaningful variable names (movie, episodes — not m/e). Never emit minified or single-line code. See docs_guide(topic='custom_code') for a clean-format example to imitate.

Keyingi nodelar {{agent_output}} orqali foydalanadi. Bog'lash: flow.connect(source=<provider_id>, source_handle='source-default', target=<agent_id>, target_handle='acc:ai_model'). Tavsiya: OpenAI yoki Ollama provider'i bilan boshlang. SUHBAT XOTIRASI: chatbot / suhbatdosh / savdo-agent uchun autoHistory=true qo'y — engine har chat uchun dialogni avtomatik eslaydi. Aks holda bot amneziyali bo'ladi (har xabarda oldingi gapni unutadi). TOOL ISHLAT: agent shunchaki matn yozmasin — real ma'lumot/harakat kerak bo'lsa acc:ai_tool'ga tool ula. Tool'siz agent uydirma javob berishi mumkin. TOOL TANLASH YO'RIQNOMASI: • dinamik DB ma'lumoti (katalog, buyurtma, foydalanuvchi) o'qish/yozish → AICollectionToolNode (read uchun operations=['read']); • tashqi REST API chaqirish → AIHTTPToolNode (natija status-aware: model 4xx/5xx xatoni ko'radi); • murakkab mantiq/hisob-kitob yoki bir nechta amal birga → AICustomCodeToolNode (kuchli — Mongo yoz, Telegram yubor, http; ehtiyot bo'l); • hujjat/bilim bazasi bo'yicha semantic (RAG) qidiruv → AIKnowledgeToolNode, LEKIN faqat tashqi Qdrant URL + embedding kaliti aniq mavjud bo'lsa (built-in vector DB YO'Q; aks holda tool jimgina tushib qoladi — o'rniga collection/http ishlat). Masalan 'narxni ayt' → AICollectionToolNode (real katalog), 'buyurtma yarat' → collection create yoki custom_code; • joriy sana/vaqt yoki sana hisobi (bron/jadval/eslatma) → AIDateTimeToolNode (credential YO'Q); • Google Sheet o'qish/yozish (lookup, log, buyurtma jurnali) → AIGoogleSheetsToolNode (type_key='google_sheets' OAuth credential, dashboard'da Connect with Google); • AI dinamik to'lov havolasi yaratsin (sotuv-agent narx aytib hisob chiqarsin) → AIPaymentLinkToolNode (paymentType click|paycue — qurishdan oldin SO'RA, payme YO'Q; maxAmount build-time injection-guard); • AI to'lov BUYURTMASI holatini tekshirsin (paid/pending/failed; 'to'ladim' deganda tasdiq) → AIPaymentStatusToolNode (order_id runtime arg, konfiguratsiya/credential YO'Q); STRUCTURED JSON: agent JSON qaytarishi kerak bo'lsa systemPrompt'da 'JSON qaytar' DEMA (ishonchsiz) — `structuredOutput:true` + `jsonSchema` (schema string) qo'y. Engine model'ni provider darajasida shu schema'ga majburlaydi va parse qilingan obyektni outputKey'ga yozadi ({{agent_output.field}}). Faqat schema'siz erkin matn kerak bo'lsa returnMode='json' (best-effort parse). XATO SEMANTIKASI (engine): SUCCESS bo'lsa errorOutputKey TOZALANADI (oldingi xato qoldig'i qolmaydi); provider XATO bersa outputKey bo'sh, errorOutputKey saqlanadi va flow KEYINGI node'ga DAVOM etadi (graceful) — shuning uchun errorOutputKey ustidan IfConditionNode bilan branch qilib xato holatini alohida ko'rsatish mumkin.

TEMPLATE (gibrid) model — har node BITTA `operation` (create|read|update|delete). read+create kerak bo'lsa BIR agentga ikki alohida collection tool ulang (har biri bitta operation). Sen (builder) so'rov SKELETINI sozlaysan, har field uchun FIXED yoki AI-SLOT tanlaysan; runtime AI faqat ai-slot'larni to'ldiradi. operation='read'/'update'/'delete' → filterMatch ('and'|'or') + filterConditions:[{field, op, source:'fixed'|'ai', value?|aiDescription?}]; op ∈ eq|ne|gt|gte|lt|lte|in|nin|contains|exists. operation='create' → documentFields:[{field, source, value?|aiDescription?}]. operation='update' → YANA changeFields (SET qilinadigan maydonlar; filterConditions QAYSI hujjat ekanini tanlaydi). source='fixed' → SEN `value` belgilaysan (constant yoki {{chat_id}}/{{state_<key>}}/{{user_id}}/{{username}} placeholder — engine runtime'da resolve qiladi, BUTUN-placeholder XOM tipni saqlaydi: value="{{chat_id}}" int qoladi). FIXED slot'ni runtime AI O'ZGARTIROLMAYDI — shuning uchun user_id="{{chat_id}}" qilib tool'ni JORIY foydalanuvchiga xavfsiz biriktir. source='ai' → `value` bo'sh, `aiDescription` yoz; runtime AI shu tavsifga qarab qiymatni to'ldiradi. MISOL read: operation='read', filterMatch='and', filterConditions=[{field:'user_id', op:'eq', source:'fixed', value:'{{chat_id}}'},{field:'status', op:'eq', source:'ai', aiDescription:'qaysi holatdagi qarzlar (masalan active)'}]. MISOL create: operation='create', documentFields=[{field:'user_id', source:'fixed', value:'{{chat_id}}'},{field:'amount', source:'ai', aiDescription:'qarz summasi'},{field:'text', source:'ai', aiDescription:'qarz izohi'}]. LEGACY (hanuz qabul qilinadi, engine fallback qiladi): `operation` bermasang eski model — `operations` allow-list + `searchFields` ([{field, description?}]); u holda runtime AI butun filtrni o'zi quradi.
